title: Arrays
goal: 1D/2D arrays, initialization, traversal, search/sort aur memory layout samajhna.
definition: Array ek hi type ke contiguous elements ka collection hai. Index 0 se shuru hota hai aur size compile time ya runtime par fixed hota hai (VLA C99 optional).
explain: Array ka naam pehle element ke address me decay hota hai; a[i] == *(a+i). Isliye bounds check C khud nahi karta — out-of-bounds read/write UB hai.
Elements memory me lagatar hote hain, isliye index arithmetic O(1) hai aur cache-friendly traversal fast hota hai.
2D array row-major hota hai: a[i][j] ka address base + (i*cols + j)*sizeof(element).
Insert/delete O(n) hain (shifting); search linear O(n), sorted array par binary O(log n).
analogy: Array ek train hai: coaches lagatar jude hain, coach number (index) se seedha pahunchte ho. Beech me coach add karna ho to peeche sab shift karna padta hai.
why: Arrays har data structure ka base hain — strings, matrices, heaps, hash tables, dynamic arrays sab inhi par bane hain.

syntax.note: sizeof trick sirf usi scope me chalti hai jahan array declare hua.

topics.title: Initialization aur traversal
topics.body: Partial init baaki elements ko 0 karta hai. for (i=0;i<n;i++) ya size_t se traverse karo. Range-based for C me nahi hai.

topics.title: Search aur sort
topics.body: Linear search O(n). Binary search sirf sorted array par O(log n). Bubble/selection/insertion O(n^2); merge/quick average O(n log n).

topics.title: 2D aur matrix
topics.body: Row/column loops, transpose (m[i][j] ↔ m[j][i]), addition, multiplication (O(n^3)). Function me 2D array pass karte waqt column width zaroori hai: void f(int m[][3]).

topics.title: Memory layout aur bounds
topics.body: Contiguous ints: address gap sizeof(int). Out-of-bounds C detect nahi karta — ASan se pakdo. Array decay se function me sizeof kaam nahi karta.

examples.title: Sum, min, max
lines: Ek hi pass me sum, min, max.
Index 0 se n-1 tak — off-by-one nahi.

examples.title: Matrix transpose
lines: Row-major order me print karte hain.

mistakes.why: Bounds check C me nahi hota; memory corrupt hoti hai.
Parameter pointer hai; sizeof pointer ka size deta hai.

debug.brief: Sum galat aa raha hai kyunki loop ek extra element padh raha hai. Fix karo.
debug.fix: for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) s += a[i];

mcqs.q: a[2] kis expression ke barabar hai?
mcqs.explain: Array indexing pointer arithmetic ka sugar hai.

interview.a: Nahi. Array ek object hai jiska size hota hai; expression me wo pehle element ke pointer me decay hota hai. sizeof array total bytes deta hai, sizeof pointer 8.
interview.followUp: Array assign? — nahi, copy ke liye memcpy/loop.

interview.a: Variable Length Array (C99): runtime size wala local array, e.g. int a[n]. C11 me optional hai; stack par banta hai — bada n stack overflow de sakta hai.

lab.title: Lab 11 — Array statistics
lab.brief: 5 numbers input lo aur sum, min, max, average print karo.
lab.solution:
#include <stdio.h>
int main(void){int a[5],s=0,lo,hi;for(int i=0;i<5;i++)scanf("%d",&a[i]);lo=hi=a[0];for(int i=0;i<5;i++){s+=a[i];if(a[i]<lo)lo=a[i];if(a[i]>hi)hi=a[i];}printf("sum=%d min=%d max=%d avg=%.2f\n",s,lo,hi,s/5.0);return 0;}
